Question ID: JOUR_U06_L02_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.JOUR.REP.02

Source: Reporting Package Verification. Task: A reporter is preparing a package about after-school tutoring attendance. Claim: Attendance increased after peer tutors began visiting ninth-grade classes. Evidence Available: sign-in sheets from September and October, one interview with the tutoring coordinator, one student quote, and a hallway observation. Verification Concern: the sign-in sheets show more names in October, but the reporter has not checked whether the increase came from classroom visits or another cause.
